title: Reversible C=C Bond Activation by an Intramolecularly Coordinated Antimony(I) Compound
abstract: AbstractInvited for the cover of this issue is the group of Libor Dostál at the University of Pardubice, Czech Republic, and colleagues at the G. A. Razuvaev Institute of Organometallic Chemistry, Nizhny Novgorod, Russia. The image depicts an amusement park designed around the antimony compounds reported in this paper.
